review_notes.evidence: header full.png shows one partial zero, MA2, and hole-damaged final two page digits; preceding two subpage characters also removed by physical hole. Lower printed page IDs are clear MA292; no invention of damaged upper print.
BE.png and N outputs left bottom.png clearly print J2, although other cards in BB/BC/BD bank print J3. Preserve source independently of A1.
AV card exact.png enlarged source shows fractured upper and lower curved counters of digit8; bearing damage retained in evidence. No A1-driven substitution.

Fresh MA292 odd_D/odd_IC crops trace D07 to AG.D07/AJ.B02; D09 to AY.D06/AT.D12; IC07 to AH.D05/AK.B07; IC09 to AZ.D04/AU.D07; IC11 to BL.D09/BG.B07; D11 to BM.B10/BF.B02. Separate unjoined crossings and source diamonds preserved.

Native MC063BD4 GATE D feeds six A lower inputs via c69/138 and horizontal r33; MC065BD4 GATE IC feeds six lower A inputs via c68/137 and r61. AQ/BC/BG lower pins are D09. All six output pins re-inspected in dedicated complete-width native crops: plain D02✲/D10✲/D02✲/D06✲/D10✲/D02✲.

I.C. OR D TO ADDRESS BUS; LOG153B; DATE08-14-69; MACH.7201-02; FRAME02; P.N.2585493; BLK.BN; revision08-08-69 713380; six connector pairs B09/B10/B11/B12/D03/D04 manually read. Original scan neighbors retained in metadata.
